notes: New: combined drawings can carry the legends from the drawings they were made from. Add Area on each drawing in New Sheet copies its legend, and the legends sit side by side down the right edge against the border, under a Combined Drawing title and the list of drawing IDs, in the legend colours, with centred text you can edit. Copied legends are never read as plan. Grid names now sit close to their lines. Claude can also make and check combined drawings with the New Sheet tool.
